newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Electric to enter U.S. PC market - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Electric to enter U.S. PC market - paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp plans to enter the U.S. personal computer (PC) market as early as this year, a Japanese business daily reported on Wednesday.

By entering the world's largest PC market, which accounts for 40 percent of the global market, Mitsubishi hopes to push its overall PC business into the black within two years, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Mitsubishi Electric plans to sell personal computer systems to small- and medium-sized firms in the United States.
A company spokesman said on Wednesday morning that he could not immediately comment on the report.
The spokesman later said that the company is currently preparing to enter the U.S. PC market, but it has not yet decided when it would launch its products there.
The spokesman also said that the company has been aiming to make its computer operations profitable in fiscal 1998/99, which starts in April 1998.
